program = '''def transform(grid):
    """Restore masked cells in a periodic grid, retaining the marked diagonal."""
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    period = max(max(row) for row in grid)
    first = grid[0][0]
    later = grid[1][0] if height > 1 else first
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height):
        start = first if r == 0 else later
        for c in range(width):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                color = (start - 1 + c) % period + 1
                if r > 0 and c == r:
                    color = (start - 1 + c - 1) % period + 1
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''

    """Fill masked cells from the repeating first-row pattern and its lower-triangle shift."""
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
